name: Rainforest Gardens
intro: New: Rainforest Gardens. Rainforest over most of the land, a river that floods in the monsoon, and an old plantation's worn-out estate. Clear or layer: a milpa burned out of the forest is rich for a few years, then the monsoon washes its fertility away; a forest garden grows upward instead, a shrub layer, an understory and at last a canopy that covers the ground. A kitchen midden with a char hearth beside it makes dark earth that never washes out. The cyclone comes in autumn, and in the dry season fire can catch where cleared ground meets the forest, unless a living fence runs between.

eraModifiers.text: Wilder weather: flood repairs cost 3 materials, and a storm can damage 2 exposed buildings.
Hotter summers: homes need 1 more cooling on summer days.

firstRains.name: First rains
firstRains.summary: the planting season: a milpa sown now makes 1 more food in summer
firstRains.description: The rains come back after the dry season. A milpa sown this season makes 1 more food in the summer after.

flood.name: Monsoon
flood.summary: heavy rain: bare fields lose fertility; the river floods its floodplain
flood.description: Heavy rain. Every farmed field with no canopy over it loses 1 fertility; a field with none left wears a step down. The river floods its floodplain: farms there gain silt (+50% food in autumn), and other buildings there that aren’t flood-tolerant are disabled for the season and cost 2 materials to repair. Homes need cooling on the humid days, unless a canopy stands beside them.

storm.name: Cyclone
storm.summary: wind; two exposed buildings on cleared land may be damaged
storm.description: A cyclone off the sea: two buildings on cleared land, with no forest beside them and no living fence along their tile, may be damaged for the season. A forest garden it strikes loses its canopy.

fire.name: Dry season
fire.summary: fire may catch where a field or scrub meets the forest
fire.description: No rain for months. Fire may catch where a field or open scrub meets open rainforest, and burn one tile of forest to scrub, unless a living fence runs between them. Solar is strong, and the river runs low.

wonder.gives: no field loses fertility in the monsoon, and every layer grows a season sooner

combos.name: Busy Bees
combos.text: An apiary next to milpas or forest gardens: +1 food on each of up to 3, spring to autumn. A wind spire next door scares the bees off.
combos.hint: Bees work the fields around them.

combos.name: Quiet Spire
combos.text: A pollinator meadow next to a wind spire cancels the spire's Harmony penalty.
combos.hint: Flowers soften the hum of the wind spires.

combos.name: Green Doorstep
combos.text: A cottage next to meadow or woodland: +1 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: People like to live near green land.

combos.name: Kitchen Loop
combos.text: Farm → scraps and biomass → composter → compost → farm. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (farms food, the composter compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Put a composter among working farms.

combos.name: Gas Loop
combos.text: Farm biomass → digester → night power, digestate back to the farms. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (farms food, the digester compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: A digester feeding the night, among working farms.

combos.name: Rice-Fish Loop
combos.text: Paddy → nutrient-rich water → farm → biomass → composter → compost → paddy. It closes when a composter stands between a paddy and a farm that got nutrient-rich water. Once it runs, each makes +1 (food, or the composter's compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: The paddy's water feeds a farm; the farm's waste feeds the paddy.

combos.name: Mushroom Loop
combos.text: Farm → biomass → mushroom cellar → spent substrate (compost) → farm. It closes when a working cellar stands next to a working farm. Once it runs, both make +1 food for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: What a farm leaves, mushrooms eat; what mushrooms leave, a farm eats.

combos.name: Village Green
combos.text: A Commons Plaza ringed by 6 buildings of at least 3 kinds: +2 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: A gathering place, surrounded on every side by a varied neighbourhood.

combos.name: Sun Terrace
combos.text: 3 solar canopies in a row, all on hills: each makes +1 day energy every season.
combos.hint: Panels stepping in a straight line along the high ground.

combos.name: Keyhole Garden
combos.text: A composter with 3 farms next to it: its compost doubles.
combos.hint: A heap at the heart of the beds.

combos.name: Water Ladder
combos.text: 3 rice-fish paddies in a row: each makes +1 food in a season it makes any.
combos.hint: Terraces stepping down, one feeding the next.

combos.name: Hearth Square
combos.text: A bathhouse, a Commons Plaza and a cottage, each touching the other two: +5 wellbeing in winter.
combos.hint: Somewhere warm to gather when it's cold.

combos.name: Rewilded Ruin
combos.text: A salvage yard whose ruin is empty becomes a Rewilded Ruin: +2 Harmony, and its worker is free.
combos.hint: What happens when nothing is left to salvage?

combos.name: Treehouse Commons
combos.text: A cottage next to 2 woodland tiles becomes a Treehouse Commons: +2 wellbeing each season instead of +1.
combos.hint: A home among the trees.

combos.name: Canal-top Solar
combos.text: A solar canopy built over a channel becomes Canal-top Solar: water still flows beneath, the whole channel loses nothing to summer evaporation, and the panels make 1 more energy by day in summer, kept cool by the water.
combos.hint: Shade the water, cool the panels.

combos.name: Singing Spire
combos.text: A wind spire with pollinator meadows on 2 sides becomes a Singing Spire: no Harmony penalty, and +1 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: Wind through flowers makes music.

combos.name: Old World Archive
combos.text: A salvage yard whose ruin is empty, next to a Seedbank Library, may become an Old World Archive instead of a Rewilded Ruin: +2 knowledge each season, with 1 worker. You choose.
combos.hint: Not everything worth keeping in a ruin is metal.

combos.name: Coppice Wood
combos.text: Coppice a woodland tile next to a workshop and it becomes a Coppice Wood: 2 materials each season with 1 worker, but it counts as meadow for Harmony (1 instead of 2). Stop coppicing and it is woodland again after 2 seasons.
combos.hint: Cut a tree low and it grows back many.

combos.name: Midden Loop
combos.text: Garden → fruit → raised house → scraps → kitchen midden ← charcoal ← char hearth, in a chain of neighbours, the midden fed and the hearth burning. Once it runs, the garden makes +1 food and the midden makes dark earth twice as fast, twice a year, for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Fruit to the house, scraps to the heap, char beside it.

combos.name: Kihamba Loop
combos.text: Bee tree → forest garden with a grown understory → leaves → stall barn → manure → garden, in a chain of neighbours. Once it runs, the garden makes +1 food and the barn +1 compost, for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Bees, bananas and a stall-fed cow, each beside the next.

combos.name: The Milpa Cycle
combos.text: A milpa that has stood 6 seasons next to a tree nursery or a forest garden becomes an Orchard Garden: food 1 / 2 / 3 / 1, 1 more for each point of fertility, and its trees keep the monsoon off the field.
combos.hint: Plant trees in an old field.

combos.name: The Forest Returns
combos.text: An orchard garden that has stood 8 seasons becomes a Forest Garden with its shrub layer, understory and canopy grown, and its land goes back under forest.
combos.hint: Leave the orchard to grow.

combos.name: Four Storeys
combos.text: A forest garden with all four storeys grown, ground, shrub, understory and canopy: +1 food in a season it makes any, and it counts as rainforest for Harmony.
combos.hint: Grow a garden all the way up.

combos.name: Subak
combos.text: A Water Temple with 3 rice terraces round it, planting and flooding together: each terrace makes +1 food in autumn.
combos.hint: A temple among the terraces.

combos.name: Living Mosaic
combos.text: Seven tenths of the land or more under rainforest, forest gardens or orchard gardens: +5 Harmony, and the dry season’s fire can’t start.
combos.hint: Keep most of the land under trees.

combos.name: Pepper on the Tree
combos.text: A forest garden’s grown canopy next to another forest garden: +1 materials in a season the canopy bears, as pepper vines climb the trees.
combos.hint: Gardens side by side, their trees grown.

combos.name: Cool Shade
combos.text: A raised house next to a forest garden’s grown canopy needs no cooling on summer days.
combos.hint: A house in the shade of the trees.

tunings.name: Mirror Film
tunings.text: Solar canopies make +1 energy in winter.

tunings.name: Night Shift
tunings.text: Workshops get a 3rd run, on night energy only.

tunings.name: Hive Mind
tunings.text: Apiaries reach 2 tiles.

tunings.name: Terraced Fields
tunings.text: Milpas make +1 food in summer and autumn.

tunings.name: Grafted Trees
tunings.text: Forest gardens make +1 food in summer and autumn.

tunings.name: Brighter Panels
tunings.text: Solar canopies make +1 day energy in spring and summer.

tunings.name: Balanced Blades
tunings.text: Wind spires make +1 energy by day and night in summer.

tunings.name: Bigger Larders
tunings.text: Cottages store 5 more food.

tunings.name: Loft Rooms
tunings.text: Cottages house 1 more citizen.

tunings.name: Lean Workshops
tunings.text: Each workshop run needs 1 energy instead of 2.

tunings.name: Deep Cells
tunings.text: Cell banks hold 2 more energy.

tunings.name: Hot Compost
tunings.text: A full composter makes 3 compost instead of 2.

tunings.name: Reading Rooms
tunings.text: Seedbank libraries make +1 knowledge every season.

tunings.name: Busy Bees
tunings.text: Each apiary helps 1 more neighbouring milpa or forest garden.

tunings.name: Festival Nights
tunings.text: A powered Commons Plaza gives +1 more wellbeing.

tunings.name: Deep Mulch
tunings.text: A forest garden’s understory mulches its ground layer +2 food instead of +1.

tunings.name: Coffee Trade
tunings.text: Shrub layers make 1 more materials in autumn.

tunings.name: Fast Canopy
tunings.text: A canopy grows in 3 seasons instead of 4.

tunings.name: Firebreaks
tunings.text: Living fences cost nothing.

tunings.name: Seed Exchange
tunings.text: Forest gardens cost 4 instead of 5.

tunings.name: Cool Houses
tunings.text: Raised houses need no cooling on summer days.

tunings.name: Second Milpa
tunings.text: Milpas make 1 more food in autumn.

tunings.name: Charcoal Kilns
tunings.text: A char hearth burns 1 biomass a season instead of 2.

charters.name: Repair Culture
charters.text: Salvage ×2: each salvage yard makes 6 a season from the same ruin. Workshops turn 2 clutter into 2 materials.

charters.name: River Keepers
charters.text: Floods do no damage; fish ponds make +1 food.

charters.name: Night Market
charters.text: +2 wellbeing each season the night slot is fully powered.

charters.name: Rewilders
charters.text: Tree nurseries improve a neighbouring tile 2 steps a season; pollinator meadows give +1 more Harmony.

charters.name: Forest First
charters.text: No milpa may burn the rainforest clear, but forest gardens make 1 more food every season.

charters.name: Swidden Rights
charters.text: Milpas cost nothing and burn the forest to meadow instead of scrub, but the rain washes fertility out in autumn as well as in the monsoon.

visions.name: Mend the Estate
visions.text: Make 85% of the healable land meadow or woodland.

visions.name: Thriving Commons
visions.text: Reach 50 citizens with wellbeing 70 or more.

projects.name: Green Terraces
projects.text: Compost worked into the worst ground: when finished, the 8 least healthy tiles of land each improve one step.

projects.name: Biochar Beds
projects.text: Biomass buried as charcoal feeds the soil for good: +6 Harmony from then on.

projects.name: Seed Vault
projects.text: The valley's seeds, catalogued and kept: +25 to the run's score.

projects.name: Festival Grounds
projects.text: A meadow stage for the turning seasons: +2 wellbeing every season from then on.

projects.name: The Long Bridge
projects.text: A timber bridge across the river: +40 to the run's score.

projects.name: Sky Garden
projects.text: Terraced gardens climbing the hills: +12 Harmony and +1 wellbeing every season from then on.

projects.name: Gift to Root City
projects.text: Seed stock, tools and stories sent ahead: +6 Seeds when the run is sent home.

wildlife.name: Hummingbirds
wildlife.text: Hummingbirds come at Harmony 20 to a forest garden whose coffee bushes have grown. In spring, gardens and milpas within 2 tiles of them make 1 more food: the hummingbirds carry the pollen.

wildlife.name: Fruit bats
wildlife.text: Fruit bats come at Harmony 40 to a garden whose canopy has grown beside the rainforest. Canopies within 2 tiles of them grow a season sooner: the bats carry the seed from tree to tree.

wildlife.name: Hornbills
wildlife.text: Hornbills come at Harmony 50 to 6 or more tiles of rainforest together. Each autumn, bare and scrub ground beside the forest heals a step: the hornbills drop the seed of the fruit they eat.

wildlife.name: Jaguars
wildlife.text: Jaguars come at Harmony 70 to 10 or more tiles of rainforest unbroken. Each range of forest they hunt gives 1 wellbeing every season.

festivals.name: Feast of the First Rains
festivals.text: Drums and the smell of wet earth as the first rains come: the milpas are sown together. +3 wellbeing, and every milpa sown this spring makes 1 more food.

festivals.name: Harvest of the Canopy
festivals.text: Ladders up the jackfruit and mango, baskets passed down hand to hand. +3 wellbeing, and every garden with its canopy grown makes 1 more food this summer.

festivals.name: Odalan
festivals.text: The water temple’s festival: offerings of fruit and flowers, gamelan into the night. +3 wellbeing, every rice terrace beside a Water Temple makes 1 more food this autumn, and the animals come out to see.

twists.name: Fair Weather
twists.text: No twist: the seasons as usual.

twists.name: Clear Skies
twists.text: Solar canopies make 1 more energy by day, but wind spires make 1 less, day and night.

twists.name: Lean Start
twists.text: The Sprout sets out with 5 materials, 4 food and 4 citizens. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Big Families
twists.text: Citizens arrive two at a time, but only when a season's harvest leaves 4 food spare after eating (usually 2).

twists.name: Scavengers' Valley
twists.text: Ruins hold 12 more salvage each (42 instead of 30), but every clutter costs 2 Harmony.

twists.name: Long Rains
twists.text: The monsoon comes again in autumn instead of the cyclone: the rain washes fertility out of the fields twice a year.

twists.name: El Niño
twists.text: No monsoon: the summer is dry, and fire can catch from the fields in summer as well as in the dry season. The river runs at half its flow all year.

twists.name: Leaf Blight
twists.text: Blight in the bananas: a forest garden’s understory bears no food, though it still feeds the ground below it and makes biomass.

regions.name: Deep Forest
regions.text: The forest as it is: rainforest over most of the land, a river winding through it with its floodplain, hills along one side, a few clearings, and the old plantation’s worn-out estate on the other.

regions.name: Old Plantation
regions.text: The old estate spreads over a third of the land, its rows worn to bare red earth, and little forest is left: a restoration run. 6 ruins, 36 salvage each.

regions.name: River Forest
regions.text: A broad river forest: floodplain two tiles wide on both banks, all of it under water every monsoon, and rich land when it drains. The Graft is one tier higher.

regions.name: Volcano Slopes
regions.text: The forest climbs a volcano’s slopes: hills over half the land, with room for terraces stepped down them, as on Kilimanjaro.

regions.name: Swidden Mosaic
regions.text: Forest, clearings and old fields at every stage of growing back: twice the clearings, and 3 of their tiles dark earth left by old gardens.

eraGoals.text: Go a full year, spring to winter, with no energy shortfall.

levels.name: Steaming Summers
levels.text: Homes need 1 more cooling on summer days.

levels.name: Quick Clutter
levels.text: Citizens make scraps faster: one for every 2 citizens instead of 3.

levels.name: Slow Healing
levels.text: Spreading compost takes 4 compost per step of healing instead of 2.

levels.name: Restless People
levels.text: The population grows only at wellbeing 70 or more, instead of 60.

levels.name: Muggy Nights
levels.text: Homes need 1 cooling on autumn days too.

levels.name: Rough Seasons
levels.text: Flood repairs cost 2 more materials, and storms can damage one more exposed building.

levels.name: Weary People
levels.text: Meeting every need no longer lifts wellbeing.

levels.name: High Hopes
levels.text: Civic life serves 10 fewer citizens before expectations cost wellbeing.

levels.name: Cramped Homes
levels.text: Cottages and raised houses house 2 citizens instead of 3.
